column1: Abstract

(EN) The invention discloses a tea tree CsU6 gene promoter as well as cloning and application thereof. The endogenous CsU6 gene promoter of the tea tree is successfully cloned for the first time, the transcriptional activity detection vector of the CsU6 gene promoter of the tea tree is successfully constructed, the transcriptional activities of the eight CsU6 promoters are compared through instantaneous transformation of tobacco leaves, GUS dyeing and GUS enzyme activity determination, the CsU6i and CsU6j promoters with the strongest transcriptional activity are selected for construction of the gene editing vector of the tea tree, and the CsU6i and CsU6j promoters with the strongest transcriptional activity are selected for construction of the gene editing vector of the tea tree. The feasibility of the two promoters applied to a tea tree CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing system is verified in the tea tree protoplast, and CRISPR/Cas9 mediated tea tree genome targeted editing is realized. Therefore, cloning of the tea tree U6 gene promoter and expression analysis of the promoter activity provide an efficient promoter sequence for research on transformation of tea trees and related plants, and efficient and accurate germplasm innovation and variety genetic improvement of the tea trees can also be realized.(ZH) 本发明公开了茶树CsU6基因启动子及其克隆与应用。本发明首次成功克隆了茶树内源CsU6基因启动子，并成功构建了茶树CsU6基因启动子转录活性检测载体，通过瞬时转化烟草叶片、GUS染色和GUS酶活测定，比较了八种CsU6启动子的转录活性，选择转录活性最强的CsU6i和CsU6j启动子用于茶树基因编辑载体构建，在茶树原生质体中验证了这两种启动子应用于茶树CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑系统的可行性，并实现了CRISPR/Cas9介导的茶树基因组靶向编辑。因此，茶树U6基因启动子克隆及启动子活性的表达分析，为研究与茶树及近缘植物的转化研究提供了高效的启动子序列，也可以实现对茶树高效精准的种质创新与品种遗传改良。

(EN) 
The invention relates to a plant genetic engineering field, and more particularly to a method for creating directed gene mutated non-transgenic plants. The method including performing a transgenic method onto directed gene mutated plants by introducing exogenous nucleic acid molecules; wherein the transgenic method includes introducing constructs into the directed gene mutated plants, each of the constructs contains a first nucleic acid molecule and a second nucleic acid molecule, wherein the first nucleic acid molecule serves as a gene editing element, and the second nucleic acid molecule serves as a lethal or stop development element, and can be used in a plant gene editing system such as CRISPR/CAS9. It can actively and automatically eliminate plant transgenic fragments, leaving enough time for gene editing elements to perform directed gene editing before removing transgenic fragments, providing a simple and effective method for gene editing without transgenic plants.

(EN) The invention discloses a method for improving a thermo-sensitive sterile rice line. The method comprises the following steps of obtaining a completely sterile rice plant with homozygous mutation of a fertility regulation gene by combining with a CRISPR/Cas9 method; constructing a wild type fertility regulation gene, an exogenous reporter gene, a pollen lethal gene and a thermo-sensitive sterile restorer gene into an expression vector to obtain a quaternary complementary vector; transforming the quaternary complementary vector into the completely sterile rice plant to obtain a transgenic complementary plant with restored fertility; and carrying out selfing on the transgenic complementary plant to obtain seeds, taking the seeds showing the exogenous reporter gene characters as reproductive line seeds, and taking the seeds not showing the characters as sterile line seeds. The invention discloses an application of the improved thermo-sensitive sterile rice line in rice hybrid seed production. The invention also discloses a recombinant vector. According to the invention, the problem that the fertility of two sterile lines is influenced by the environment and rice lodging is caused can be fundamentally solved, and the transition from two-line hybrid rice to third-generation hybrid rice is realized.(ZH) 本发明公开了改良水稻温敏不育系的方法，包括：结合CRISPR/Cas9方法，获取到育性调控基因纯合突变的完全不育水稻植株；将野生型育性调控基因、外源报告基因、花粉致死基因和温敏不育恢复基因构建入一个表达载体中，得到四元互补载体；将四元互补载体转化入完全不育水稻植株中，得到育性恢复的转基因互补植株；转基因互补植株自交获取种子，表现外源报告基因性状的种子作为繁殖系种子，未表现出性状的种子作为不育系种子。本发明公开了改良的水稻温敏不育系在水稻杂交制种中的应用。本发明还公开了重组载体。本发明可从根本上解决两系不育系育性受环境影响而打摆子的问题，实现两系杂交水稻到第三代杂交水稻的过渡。

(EN) The invention provides SvMOC1 gene expression for regulating and controlling tiller number of broomcorn plants and application, belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering application, and particularly discloses application of SvMOC1 gene of green bristlegrass in regulating and controlling tiller number of green bristlegrass. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing vector of the SvMOC1 gene, then introducing the CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing vector into setaria viridis, and analyzing the function of the SvMOC1 gene in the setaria viridis. The result shows that after the SvMOC1 gene in the green bristlegrass is inactivated, a multi-tillering phenotype is changed into a single-stem phenotype. The SvMOC1 gene disclosed by the invention has an important application value in the aspect of improving the tiller number of green bristlegrass, and can provide a theoretical basis for the tillering regulation and control mechanism research of other related gramineous plants.(ZH) 本发明提供一种用于调控黍亚科植物分蘖数的SvMOC1基因表达及应用，属于基因工程应用技术领域，具体公开了狗尾草SvMOC1基因在调控狗尾草分蘖数中的应用。本发明首先构建SvMOC1基因的CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑载体，然后将CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑载体导入狗尾草，分析SvMOC1基因在狗尾草中的功能。结果表明，狗尾草中SvMOC1基因失活后，由多分蘖表型变为单杆表型。本发明公开的SvMOC1基因在改良狗尾草分蘖数方面有着重要的应用价值，可以为其它近缘禾本科植物的分蘖调控机理研究提供理论依据。

(EN) This invention relates to Type V CRISPR-Cas effector proteins, deaminases, and fusion and recruiting nucleic acid constructs thereof. The invention further relates methods of targeted nucleic acid modification utilizing the same. One aspect of the invention provides a method of modifying a target nucleic acid, the method comprising contacting the target nucleic acid with: (a) a Type V CRISPR-Cas effector protein; (b) a deaminase, optionally wherein the target nucleic acid is contacted with two or more deaminase; and(c) a guide nucleic acid, wherein the deaminase is recruited to the Type V CRISPR-Cas effector protein (e.g., recruited via a protein to protein interaction, RNA to protein interaction, and/or chemical interaction), thereby modifying the target nucleic acid, optionally wherein the Type V CRISPR-Cas effector protein, the deaminase and guide nucleic acid are co-expressed.(FR) L'invention concerne des protéines effectrices CRISPR-Cas de type V, des désaminases et des constructions d'acides nucléiques de fusion et de recrutement de celles-ci. L'invention concerne en outre des procédés de modification ciblée d'acide nucléique l'utilisant. Un aspect de l'invention concerne un procédé de modification d'un acide nucléique cible, le procédé comprenant la mise en contact de l'acide nucléique cible avec : (A) une protéine effectrice CRISPR-Cas de type V; (b) une désaminase, l'acide nucléique cible étant mis éventuellement en contact avec deux désaminase ou plus; et (c) un acide nucléique de guidage, la désaminase étant recrutée à la protéine effectrice CRISPR-Cas de type V (par exemple, recrutée par l'intermédiaire d'une interaction protéine-protéine, d'une interaction ARN-protéine et/ou d'une interaction chimique), modifiant ainsi l'acide nucléique cible, la protéine effectrice CRISPR-Cas de type V, la désaminase et l'acide nucléique de guidage étant éventuellement co-exprimées.

(EN) The present invention relates generally to methods of modifying the genome of an organism comprising contacting genome of the organism with a composition comprising a CRISPR-Cas nucleic acid and a polyalkyleneimine-alkoxylene polymer such as a polyethyleneimine (PEI)-polyethylene oxide (PEO) polymer. The present invention also relates to methods of using the compositions of the invention to kill cells.(FR) La présente invention concerne de manière générale des méthodes de modification du génome d'un organisme, comprenant la mise en contact du génome de l'organisme avec une composition comprenant un acide nucléique CRISPR-Cas et un polymère de polyalkylèneimine-alcoxylène tel qu'un polymère de polyéthylèneimine (PEI)-oxyde de polyéthylène (PEO). La présente invention concerne en outre des méthodes d'utilisation des composition de l'invention pour tuer des cellules.

(EN) The invention discloses a kit and a detection method capable of rapidly detecting pathogenic bacteria fusarium of maize stem rot, Cas protein is Cas12, the kit comprises an RPA primer and crRNA, the fusarium comprises fusarium graminearum, and the RPA primer and the crRNA of the fusarium graminearum are respectively a primer combination FgraF2/FgraR2 and Fg-crRNA. Aiming at the corn stalk rot pathogenic bacteria with wide distribution, high separation frequency and strong pathogenicity, the invention develops a corn stalk rot pathogenic bacteria on-site visual rapid detection technology based on combination of a recombinase polymerase amplification technology and CRISPR/Cas12a (Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats/CRISPR/CRISPR/CRISPR/Cas12a). According to the technology, reaction can be carried out under the constant temperature condition of 37-42 DEG C, complex instruments and equipment are not needed, and CRISPR/Cas12a can recognize and cut a specific nucleic acid sequence, so that the detection specificity and sensitivity are further improved on the basis of RPA.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种可快速检测玉米茎腐病病原菌镰孢菌的试剂盒及检测方法，Cas蛋白为Cas12，所述试剂盒包括RPA引物和crRNA，所述镰孢菌包括禾谷镰孢菌，禾谷镰孢菌的RPA引物和crRNA分别为引物组合FgraF2/FgraR2、Fg‑crRNA。本发明针对分布广、分离频率高、致病性强的玉米茎腐病病原菌，开发基于重组酶聚合酶扩增技术结合CRISPR/Cas12a的玉米茎腐病病原菌现场可视化快速检测技术。该技术可在37‑42℃恒温条件下进行反应，无需复杂的仪器设备，CRISPR/Cas12a可识别并切割特定核酸序列，从而在RPA基础上进一步增加了检测的特异性和灵敏度。

(EN) The present invention relates to a method for directionally editing genes of brassica oleracea var.capitata by utilizing CRISPR/Cas9 and an application of the method, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The method comprises the following steps: designing sgRNA by taking a sequence of a BoGASA gene of the brassica oleracea var.capitata as a reference, constructing an sgRNA vector of theBoGASA gene, transforming agrobacteria by using recombinant plasmids, and carrying out agrobacterium-mediated genetic transformation of brassica oleracea var.capitata cotyledons with petioles and molecular detection on transformed plants. A set of complete gene editing technical system of the brassica oleracea var.capitata is established on the basis. The method is of great significance to development of reverse genetics researches of the brassica oleracea var.capitata and gene function analysis of other cruciferae plants.(ZH) 本发明涉及一种利用CRISPR/Cas9定向编辑结球甘蓝基因的方法及应用，属于生物技术领域。该方法包括以结球甘蓝BoGASA基因序列为参照设计sgRNA、构建BoGASA基因的sgRNA载体、重组质粒转化农杆菌、农杆菌介导结球甘蓝带柄子叶遗传转化及转化植株的分子检测，在此基础上建立了一套完整的结球甘蓝基因编辑技术体系，对于结球甘蓝反向遗传学研究的开展和其他十字花科植物基因功能解析具有重要意义。

(EN) The invention belongs to the technical field of gene engineering, particularly relates to a potato U6 RNA polymerase III type promoter, more particularly relates to StU64-1 and StU68-1 gene promoters, and further discloses a cloning method and application thereof. Two potato RNA polymerase III type promoters StU64-1 and StU68-1 are obtained by cloning in potatoes, have efficient transcriptional activity and can drive downstream sgRNA expression, and the activities of the two promoters and the feasibility of applying the promoters to potato CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing are respectively verified by virtue of an instantaneous transformation system of nicotiana benthamiana leaves and a stable transformation system of potatoes, and the CRISPR/Cas9 guided potato genome editing is realized. In the technical field of transgenosis, the promoters are not only suitable for potatoes, but also can be applied to other solanaceae crops such as tobacco.(ZH) 本发明属于基因工程技术领域，具体涉及马铃薯U6 RNA聚合酶III型启动子，更具体涉及StU6 4‑1和StU6 8‑1基因启动子,并进一步公开其克隆方法与应用。本发明在马铃薯中克隆获得两种马铃薯RNA聚合酶III型启动子StU6 4‑1和StU6 8‑1，它们具有高效转录活性，可驱动下游sgRNA表达，并通过本氏烟草叶片瞬时转化和马铃薯稳定转化体系，分别验证了这两种启动子的活性及其应用于马铃薯CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑的可行性，实现了CRISPR/Cas9引导的马铃薯基因组编辑。在转基因技术领域，这些启动子不仅适用于马铃薯，还可应用于烟草等其它茄科作物。

(EN) The present invention provides materials and methods for conferring geminivirus resistance to plants or plant cells, and particularly to materials and methods for using CRISPR/Cas or CRISPR/Cpf1 systems to confer resistance to geminiviruses. Materials and methods are described to insert sequence at a double stranded break in a geminivirus genome.(ZH) 赋予植物或植物细胞双生病毒抗性的材料和方法，特别是使用CRISPR/Cas或CRISPR/Cpf1系统赋予对双生病毒抗性的材料和方法。描述了材料和方法以在双生病毒基因组中的双链断裂处插入序列。

(EN) Described herein are engineered CRISPR-Cas proteins and methods of use of such proteins. In particular Type V CRISPR-Cas nucleases, like Cas12a, having a nuclease or nickase domain from a non-type V CRISPR-Cas nuclease inserted in the interdomain linker region between the Rec1 and Rec2 domains. Also described herein are complexes, compositions, and systems including engineered proteins of the present invention, each of which may be used for modifying or editing a target nucleic acid. An engineered protein of the present invention may be an enzyme and/or may be an RNA-guided DNA-binding protein.(FR) La présente invention concerne des protéines CRISPR-Cas ingéniérisées et leurs procédés d'utilisation. L'invention concerne en particulier des nucléases CRISPR-Cas de type V, telles que la nucléase Cas12a, ayant un domaine nucléase ou nickase provenant d'une nucléase CRISPR-Cas qui n'est pas de type V inséré dans la région de liaison interdomaine entre les domaines Rec1 et Rec2. L'invention concerne également des complexes, des compositions et des systèmes comprenant des protéines ingéniérisées de la présente invention, chacune desquelles pouvant être utilisée pour modifier ou éditer un acide nucléique cible. Une protéine ingéniérisée de la présente invention peut être une enzyme et/ou peut être une protéine de liaison à l'ADN guidée par ARN.

(EN) The invention relates to the field of gene engineering, and discloses application of a method for improving herbicide resistance of leguminous plants by mutating at least one amino acid site in herbicide target protein to preparation of leguminous plants with herbicide resistance. The method can effectively solve the problem that in the prior art, it is difficult to conduct herbicide-resistant breeding on leguminous plants through a CRISPR/Cas9 mediated single base editing technology. The leguminous plants prepared by the method have the characteristic of obvious herbicide resistance, can wellsolve the problem that the herbicide has negative influence on crop growth in weed control when being applied to breeding and planting of the leguminous plants, especially soybeans, and effectively avoids the adverse influence on crop production due to improper use of the herbicide.(ZH) 本发明涉及基因工程领域，公开了突变除草剂靶标蛋白中的至少一个氨基酸位点以提高豆科植物除草剂抗性的方法在制备具有除草剂抗性的豆科植物中的用途。该方法能够有效解决现有技术中对豆科植物难以采用CRISPR/Cas9介导的单碱基编辑技术进行抗除草剂育种的问题。通过该方法制备获得的豆科植物植株具有明显抗除草剂的特性，将其应用于豆科植物尤其是大豆的育种和种植中可以很好地解决杂草防治中除草剂对作物生长具有负面影响的问题，有效避免了除草剂使用不当对作物生产的不利影响。

(EN) The invention discloses an application of inhibiting the expression of an HSRP1 gene in improving the heat resistance of a plant. The gene number of the HSRP1 gene in a TAIR official website is AT4G37930. According to the invention, an arabidopsis HSRP1 gene is obtained through plant genome cloning, a CRISPR-Cas9 gene knockout vector of the HSRP1 gene is constructed, and an HSRP1 gene knockout transgenic line is obtained by using an agrobacterium-mediated method. The inventor reveals the effect of HSRP1 in plant heat resistance through a culture medium heat stress simulation experiment, and a gene resource is provided for heat-resistant molecular breeding of crops. The plant can survive and grow in a temperature range beyond the original adaptive temperature range, and a new way is provided for molecular breeding and genetic modification of the plant.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种抑制HSRP1基因的表达在提高植物耐热性中的应用，所述HSRP1基因在TAIR官方网站的基因号为AT4G37930。本发明通过植物基因组克隆获得拟南芥HSRP1基因，构建了HSRP1基因CRISPR‑Cas9基因敲除载体，利用农杆菌介导的方法获得HSRP1基因敲除转基因系。发明人通过培养基热胁迫模拟实验，揭示了HSRP1在植物耐热中的作用，为作物耐热分子育种提供基因资源。可使植物能够在超出其原本的适应的温度范围内存活和生长，为植物的分子育种和遗传改造提供了一种新的途径。

(EN) The present invention relates to a method for producing a tomato plant having controlled disease resistance by gene editing and a tomato plant produced by the production method and, more specifically, to a tomato plant having controlled resistance to biotrophic and/or saprophytic pathogens, wherein the tomato-derived plant immune regulator  SUPPRESSOR OF rps4-RLD1 (SRFR1) gene is edited using a CRISPR/Cas system.(FR) La présente invention concerne un procédé de production d'un plant de tomate ayant une résistance à la maladie commandée par édition de gène et un plant de tomate produit par le procédé de production et, plus précisément, un plant de tomate ayant une résistance commandée à des pathogènes biotrophes et/ou saphotiques, le gène régulateur immunitaire végétal dérivé de la tomate  SUPPRESSEUR DE rps4-RLD1 (SRFR1) étant édité à l'aide d'un système CRISPR/Cas.(KO) 본 발명은 유전자 교정을 이용한 병 저항성이 조절된 토마토 식물체의 제조방법 및 상기 제조방법에 의해 제조된 토마토 식물체에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 토마토 유래 식물면역조절인자 SRFR1 (SUPPRESSOR OF rps4-RLD1) 유전자를 CRISPR/Cas 시스템을 이용하여 교정한 기생영양(biotrophic) 및/또는 사물기생성 병원균에 대한 저항성이 조절된 토마토 식물체에 관한 것이다.

(EN) The invention relates to a DNA modifying enzyme comprising or consisting of a DNA editing protein and a Cas protein and a peptide linker,wherein said DNA editing protein and said Cas protein are connected by said peptide linker; andwherein said DNA modifying enzyme has been obtained by directed molecular evolution of an original enzyme; andwherein said DNA modifying enzyme shows a base editing rate which is at least 10%, 20% or 30 %, preferably at least 40 %, more preferably at least 50 %, most preferably at least 60 % higher than the base editing rate of said wildtype enzyme.The invention relates further to a method of directed molecular evolution of a DNA modifying enzyme and to the use evolved DNA modifying enzymes in research, medicine and agriculture.

(EN) The invention discloses application of NPF7.6 protein in regulation and control of nitrogen tolerance of leguminous plant root nodules. The amino acid sequence of the NPF7.6 protein is shown as SEQ ID No.2. The invention provides a method for improving nitrogen resistance of leguminous plant root nodules, which comprises the following steps of editing a gene for coding NPF7.6 protein at a fixed point by utilizing a CRISPR/Cas9 technology, namely knocking out a medicago truncatula NPF7.6 gene, so as to obtain a new germplasm of which the root nodule nitrogen resistance is obviously improved; and the nitrogen resistance of the root nodules is improved by increasing the biomass of the root nodules and increasing the length of the root nodules. The application has important application value for plant breeding.(ZH) 本发明公开了NPF7.6蛋白在调控豆科植物根瘤耐氮性中的应用，NPF7.6蛋白的氨基酸序列是SEQ ID No.2所示。本发明提供了一种提高豆科植物根瘤耐氮性的方法，利用CRISPR/Cas9技术定点编辑编码NPF7.6蛋白的基因，即敲除蒺藜苜蓿NPF7.6基因，获得了根瘤耐氮性显著提高的新种质；根瘤耐氮性提高体现为根瘤生物量的增加和根瘤长度的增加。本发明对植物育种具有重大的应用价值。

(EN) The invention discloses clone of a tomato transcription factor SlBT1 and application of the clone. The clone of the tomato transcription factor SlBT1 can be applied to cultivation of salt-tolerant tomatoes. The cloning of the tomato transcription factor SlBT1 comprises the following steps: firstly, obtaining an sgRNA target sequence of an SlBT1 gene; then constructing a CRISPR/Cas9 carrier, namely designing an sgRNA amplification primer and constructing the carrier according to the selected target spot sequence; carrying out tomato transformation; identifying the regenerated plant and measuring the salt tolerance; experimental results show that leaves of the wild type are yellowed under the salt stress condition, leaves from the first leaf to the fourth leaf fall off, and the SlBT1-5-23 strain and the SlBT1-1-3 strain show better salt tolerance; the gene editing SlBT1 disclosed by the invention can obviously improve the tolerance of tomatoes to salt stress, can be used for preparing saline-alkali soil resistant materials of the tomatoes, and has a relatively high application value.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种番茄转录因子SlBT1的克隆及其应用，番茄转录因子SlBT1的克隆可用于耐盐番茄的培育中；番茄转录因子SlBT1的克隆先通过SlBT1基因的sgRNA靶点序列的获得；然后进行CRISPR/Cas9载体的构建，包括根据选定的靶点序列，设计sgRNA扩增引物和载体构建；再进行番茄转化；经过再生植株的鉴定和耐盐性测定；通过实验结果表明野生型受盐胁迫条件下出现叶片黄化，第一片到第四片的叶片有脱落现象，而SlBT1‑5‑23和SlBT1‑1‑3株系，表现更具有耐盐性；本发明基因编辑SlBT1能显著提高番茄对盐胁迫的耐受性，可制备番茄抗盐碱地的材料，具有较高的应用价值。

(EN) The invention relates to a nucleic acid detection method for detecting soybean plant MON87705, which comprises the following steps of: constructing a lateral flow chromatography sensor by using a dual loop-mediated isothermal amplification technology, a strand displacement reaction and CRISPR/Cas12a, designing an SD reaction sequence according to an LAMP product of a soybean reference gene Lectin, designing crRNA according to an LAMP product of a specific sequence of a transformant of transgenic soybean MON87705, and detecting the transgenic soybean MON87705. The logic detection of the specific sequences of the soybean reference gene Lectin and the transgenic soybean MON87705 transformant can be realized only by respectively reading the detection results of the LFB twice in one detection process by utilizing the trans-cleavage activity of the reaction of the base complementation principle and CRISPR/Cas12a (Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats/CRISPR/CRISPR/CRISPR/CRISPR/CRISPR/CRISPR/CRISPR/Cas12a).(ZH) 本发明涉及一种用于检测大豆植物MON87705的核酸检测方法，以双重环介导等温扩增技术、链置换反应、CRISPR/Cas12a构建侧流层析传感器，根据大豆内参基因Lectin的LAMP产物设计SD反应序列，根据转基因大豆MON87705转化体特异性序列的LAMP产物设计crRNA，利用碱基互补原理与CRISPR/Cas12a反应的反式切割活性，只需在一次检测流程中分别读取两次LFB的检测结果，即可实现大豆内参基因Lectin与转基因大豆MON87705转化体特异性序列的逻辑化检测。

(EN) The invention relates to the technical field of genetic engineering, in particular to a gene BnC04BIN2-like1 for adjusting and controlling signal transduction of brassinolide and an application of thegene BnC04BIN2-like1. The gene BnC04BIN2-like1 for negatively adjusting and controlling signal transduction of plant brassinolide is obtained through clonal separation on short-stem mutation materials "MB1501-1" of brassica napus, and replacement of 11 bases is carried out between the gene and a reference gene. A PBI121-BnC04BIN2-like1 overexpression vector and a CRISPR-BnC04BIN2-like1 vector areconstructed, a PBI121-BnC04BIN2-like1 overexpression transgenic plant is obtained, and a dwarf phenotype appears; and meanwhile, a CRISPR-BnC04BIN2-like1 transgenic plant is obtained, and the transgenic plant restores the tall-stem phenotype. The BnC04BIN2-like1 gene obtained through cloning can negatively adjust and control the signal transduction of the brassinolide, so that the plant height trait of the brassica napus can be controlled.(ZH) 本发明为基因工程技术领域，具体涉及一个调控油菜素内酯信号转导的基因BnC04BIN2‑like1及其应用。本发明从甘蓝型油菜矮杆突变材料“MB1501‑1”克隆分离得到负调控植物油菜素内酯信号转导的基因BnC04BIN2‑like1，该基因与参考基因有11个碱基的替换。本发明构建了PBI121‑BnC04BIN2‑like1过表达载体和CRISPR‑BnC04BIN2‑like1载体，获得了PBI121‑BnC04BIN2‑like1过表达转基因植株，出现矮化表型；同时获得了CRISPR‑BnC04BIN2‑like1转基因植株，转基因植株恢复高杆表型。克隆得到的BnC04BIN2‑like1基因能够负调控油菜素内酯的信号转导，从而控制油菜株高性状。

(EN) 
The present disclosure provides compositions, methods, and systems for targeted plant genome editing. In some embodiments, the present disclosure provides recombinant self-replicating RNAs derived from a plant virus vector, such as those derived from Tobacco Mosaic Virus (TMV). In some embodiments, the recombinant self-replicating RNAs direct the expression of both a CRISPR endonuclease and a guide RNA capable of directing sequence-specific binding of the CRISPR endonuclease to a target DNA in the genome of plant cell.

(EN) The present invention relates to hybrid nucleic acid sequence constructs comprising a CRISPR nucleic acid sequence and a DNA repair template associated with each other in a covalent and/or non-covalent way for CRISPR based genome engineering. Further provided is a molecular complex additionally comprising at least one CRISPR polypeptide. All components within the complex are in physical proximity. In addition, there is provided a plant, plant cell, a plant material, or a derivative, or progeny thereof comprising the hybrid RNA/DNA sequence and/or the molecular complex. Further, there is provided a method for modifying at least one DNA target sequence in a prokaryotic or eukaryotic cell as well as a method for manufacturing a plant or plant cell. Finally, there is provided the use of at least one hybrid RNA/DNA sequence, or use of a molecular complex for gene editing or genome engineering in a prokaryotic or eukaryotic cell or organism.(FR) La présente invention concerne des constructions de séquence d’acides nucléiques hybrides comprenant une séquence d’acides nucléiques CRISPR et une matrice de réparation d’ADN associés l’un à l’autre d’une manière covalente et/ou non covalente pour l’ingénierie génomique à base de CRISPR. L'invention concerne en outre un complexe moléculaire comprenant additionnellement au moins un polypeptide CRISPR. Tous les constituants au sein du complexe se trouvent en proximité physique. De plus, l'invention concerne une plante, une cellule végétale, un matériau végétal, ou un dérivé ou descendance de ces derniers comprenant la séquence d’ARN/d’ADN hybride et/ou le complexe moléculaire. L'invention concerne en outre un procédé de modification d’au moins une séquence cible d’ADN dans une cellule procaryote ou eucaryote ainsi qu’un procédé de fabrication d’une plante ou d’une cellule végétale. Enfin, l'invention concerne l’utilisation d’au moins une séquence d’ARN/d’ADN hybride, ou l’utilisation d’un complexe moléculaire d’édition de gène ou d’ingénierie génomique dans une cellule ou un organisme procaryote ou eucaryote.

(EN) The invention discloses a plant gene editing system based on an eggplant mottle dwarf virus (EMDV). The plant gene editing system comprises: a) an EMDV vector; b) inserting an introduced heterologous nucleic acid sequence transcription unit into an eggplant mottle dwarf virus vector genome for expressing a sequence-specific Cas9 nuclease and exonuclease fusion protein; c) inserting another introduced heterologous nucleic acid sequence transcription unit into an eggplant mottle dwarf virus vector genome for expressing CRISPR guide RNA (Ribonucleic Acid); wherein the eggplant dwarf mottle virus infects a plant transient expression heterologous sequence, Cas9 nuclease is guided by guide RNA to cut a specific genome DNA sequence of the plant, and exonuclease further digests a DNA terminal to generate sequence deletion. According to the present invention, the EMDV can efficiently and stably express the Cas9-TREX2 and Cas9-T5 fusion protein and the guide RNA in the infected tobacco tissue;(ZH) 本发明公开了一种基于茄子斑驳矮化病毒的植物基因编辑系统，包括：a)一个EMDV病毒载体；b)一个引入的异源的核酸序列转录单元被插入茄子斑驳矮化病毒载体基因组中，用于表达序列特异性Cas9核酸酶和外切核酸酶融合蛋白；c)另一个引入的异源的核酸序列转录单元被插入茄子斑驳矮化病毒载体基因组中，用于表达CRISPR向导RNA；其中，茄子矮化斑驳病毒侵染植物瞬时表达异源序列，Cas9核酸酶由向导RNA引导切割植物特定基因组DNA序列，外切核酸酶进一步消化DNA末端产生序列缺失。本申请EMDV在侵染的烟草组织中可高效稳定地表达Cas9‑TREX2和Cas9‑T5融合蛋白及向导RNA。

(EN) The invention discloses a related gene influencing tobacco plastid pigment synthesis and application. The related gene influencing tobacco plastid pigment synthesis is derived from tobacco and is named as pectate-like lyase (SPL), and the nucleotide sequence of the gene is shown as SEQ ID NO.1. The CRISPR/Cas9-spl editing vector for knocking out the pectate-like lyase gene is constructed by virtue of a CRISPR/Cas9-spl mediated gene editing technology, a Honghua Dajinyuan plant in which the pectate-like lyase gene is subjected to insertion mutation is obtained after genetic transformation, and the contents of neoxanthine, xanthophyll, chlorophyll b and chlorophyll a in 423 leaves of the obtained editing plant are remarkably increased, so that the content of the CCRISPR/Cas9-spl editing vector is remarkably increased, and the content of the CCRISPR/Cas9-spl editing vector is remarkably increased. The knockout of the gene can influence the plastid pigment content of the plant leaf, so that a genetic material and a theoretical basis are provided for tobacco plastid pigment synthesis pathway research, tobacco leaf quality improvement and tobacco variety genetic improvement.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种影响烟草质体色素合成相关的基因及应用。该影响烟草质体色素合成相关的基因来源于烟草，命名为类果胶裂解酶(SPL)，其核苷酸序列如SEQ ID NO.1所示。本发明通过CRISPR/Cas9介导的基因编辑技术，构建了用于敲除类果胶裂解酶基因的CRISPR/Cas9‑spl编辑载体，经遗传转化后获得了类果胶裂解酶基因发生插入突变的红花大金元植株，所获编辑植株423叶片中的新黄质、叶黄素、叶绿素b、叶绿素a含量显著增加，表明该基因的敲除可影响植株叶片质体色素含量，这为烟草质体色素合成通路研究，烟叶品质改善、烟草品种遗传改良提供遗传材料和理论依据。

(EN) The invention provides a method for creating a novel two-line rice sterile line based on a gene editing technology, and belongs to the fields of gene engineering and crop genetic breeding. According to the method, a CRISPR/Cas9 technology is used for performing fixed-point editing on an indica-japonica hybrid embryo sac abortion control gene S5 in two-line sterile line rice, and the rice S5 gene is knocked out by causing frameshift mutation of the S5. According to the method, the sterility of the indica-japonica rice subspecies hybrid is overcome, so that the application of the hybrid advantage of the indica-japonica rice subspecies hybrid in hybrid rice becomes possible, and the method has good development and application prospects.(ZH) 本发明提供了一种基于基因编辑技术创制水稻新型两系不育系的方法，属于基因工程领域和作物遗传育种领域。本发明方法为利用CRISPR/Cas9技术定点编辑两系不育系水稻中控制籼粳杂种胚囊败育基因S5，通过造成S5的移码突变，敲除水稻S5基因。本发明克服了水稻籼粳亚种间杂种的不育性，使得籼粳稻亚种杂交的杂种优势在杂交水稻中的应用成为可能，具有良好的开发和运用前景。
(EN) Materials and methods for gene targeting using Clustered Regularly Interspersed Short Palindromic Repeats/CRISPR-associated (CRISPR/Cas) systems are provided herein.

(EN) This invention relates to recombinant nucleic constructs comprising Type V CRISPR-Cas effector proteins, reverse transcriptases and extended guide nucleic acids and methods of use thereof for modifying nucleic acids in plants. In a first aspect, a method of modifying a target nucleic acid is provided, the method comprising: contacting the target nucleic acid with (a) a Type V CRISPR-Cas effector protein or a Type II CRISPR-Cas effector protein; (b) a reverse transcriptase, and (c) an extended guide nucleic acid (e.g., extended Type II or Type V CRISPR RNA, extended Type II or Type V CRISPR DNA, extended Type II or Type V crRNA, extended Type II or Type V crDNA), thereby modifying the target nucleic acid.(FR) La présente invention concerne des constructions d'acides nucléiques recombinants comprenant des protéines effectrices CRISPR-Cas de type V, des transcriptases inverses et des acides nucléiques guides étendus et des procédés d'utilisation de ceux-ci pour modifier des acides nucléiques dans des plantes. Selon un premier aspect, l'invention concerne un procédé de modification d'un acide nucléique cible, le procédé comprenant : la mise en contact de l'acide nucléique cible avec (a) une protéine effectrice CRISPR-Cas de type V ou une protéine effectrice CRISPR-Cas de type II ; (b) une transcriptase inverse, et (c) un acide nucléique guide étendu (par exemple, ARN CRISPR de type II ou de type V étendu, ADN CRISPR de type II ou de type V étendu, ARNcr de type II ou de type V étendu, ADNcr de type II ou de type V étendu), ce qui permet de modifier l'acide nucléique cible.

(EN) The invention discloses a rice-derived insect-resistant related gene OsLRR6 as well as an encoding product and application thereof. The insect-resistant gene is a DNA sequence shown in SEQ ID No. 1. Acomplete coding frame of the gene is base sequences from 42nd to 794th in SEQ ID No. 1, and a small molecular weight protein for coding 250 amino acid residues is shown in SEQ ID No. 2. Research finds that DNA fragments from 200th to 219th in a full-length DNA sequence as shown in the SEQ ID No.1 of the gene are closely related to the insect resistance of rice, the DNA fragments are mutated by utilizing a CRISPR/Cas9 technology, and the resistance of the rice to rice planthoppers can be enhanced by reducing the expression level of the gene. The method can be widely applied to crop breeding, especially to insect-resistant breeding of rice.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种水稻源抗虫相关基因OsLRR6及其编码产物与应用，该抗虫基因为SEQ ID No.1的DNA序列。该基因完整编码框为SEQ ID No.1中的第42到第794的碱基序列，编码250个氨基酸残基的小分子量蛋白，见SEQ ID No.2。研究发现该基因全长DNA序列SEQ ID No.1中的第200到第219的DNA片段与水稻的抗虫性密切相关，利用CRISPR/Cas9技术突变该DNA片段、降低该基因的表达水平能增强水稻对稻飞虱的抗性。本发明将在作物育种，特别是在水稻抗虫育种中得到广泛应用。

(EN) The invention relates to application of an arabidopsis HMP46 gene in improvement of cadmium stress resistance of plants, and discloses application of the arabidopsis HMP46 gene in improvement of cadmium stress resistance of the plants, which discovers that the expression of the HMP46 gene is obviously up-regulated under the induction of cadmium stress, an HMP46 gene mutation vector is constructed through a CRISPR (clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats) technology, and an arabidopsis HMP46 gene mutant is obtained and is used for analyzing the biological function of the HMP46 gene in regulation and control of the cadmium stress resistance of the arabidopsis. The arabidopsis thaliana HMP46 gene mutant is sensitive to cadmium stress, which shows that under the cadmium stress condition of a certain concentration, the elongation and chlorophyll content of the HMP46 gene mutant root are obviously lower than those of a wild plant. Experiments confirm that the arabidopsis thaliana HMP46 gene has potential application value in the aspect of improving the cadmium stress resistance of plants, and a good theoretical and application foundation is laid for cultivating cadmium-tolerant high-yield crop varieties by using the arabidopsis thaliana HMP46 gene.(ZH) 一种拟南芥HMP46基因在提高植物镉胁迫抗性中的应用，本发明发现HMP46基因表达受镉胁迫诱导显著上调，通过CRISPR技术构建HMP46基因突变载体，并由此获得了拟南芥HMP46基因突变体，用于分析HMP46基因调控拟南芥镉胁迫耐受性的生物学功能；所述拟南芥HMP46基因突变体对镉胁迫较为敏感，表现为在一定浓度的镉胁迫条件下，HMP46基因突变体根的伸长及叶绿素含量都显著低于野生型植物。本发明通过实验确认了拟南芥HMP46基因在提高植物镉胁迫抗性方面具有潜在的应用价值，并为利用拟南芥HMP46基因培育耐镉高产的农作物品种奠定了良好的理论和应用基础。

(EN) A method for obtaining glyphosate-resistant rice by a site-directed nucleotide substitution is provided, which comprises the following steps: only substituting threonine (T) at position 8 of the amino acid sequence of a conserved region of endogenous EPSPS protein of a target plant with isoleucine (I), and substituting proline (P) at position 12 with serine (S) to obtain a plant， i.e., a glyphosate-resistant plant. A method capable of generating a site-directed nucleotide substitution and a fragment substitution utilizing a CRISPR-mediated NHEJ pathway to substitute a region between two gRNA sites by designing the two gRNA sites is provided.(FR) L'invention concerne un procédé permettant d'obtenir du riz résistant au glyphosate par substitution de nucléotide dirigée, ledit procédé comprenant les étapes suivantes : substitution, uniquement, de la thréonine (T) en position 8 de la séquence d'acides aminés d'une région conservée de la protéine EPSPS endogène d'une plante cible par l'isoleucine (I); et substitution de la proline (P) en position 12 par la sérine (S). On obtient ainsi une plante, à savoir une plante résistante au glyphosate. L'invention concerne également un procédé apte à effectuer une substitution de nucléotide dirigée et une substitution de fragment par une voie NHEJ à médiation par CRISPR afin de remplacer une région entre deux sites d'ARN guide, en concevant les deux sites d'ARN guide.

(EN) The invention relates to an editing method for a CRISPR-Cas9 gene of bees. Firstly, Cas9 protein and a target gene gRNA are mixed into a mixed solution with the final concentration of 500 ng/ul. Then,the mixed solution is injected into fertilized bee eggs laid in a time period shorter than or equal to 1.5 hours, each fertilized bee egg is injected with the mixed solution with the injection volumeof 1.2 nano liters, and micro-injection for the bee eggs is completed within one hour. The bee eggs after injection are placed in a constant-temperature constant-humidity culture box for being cultured until small larvae are hatched, the bee eggs are cultured at 34.5 DEG C, and the relative humidity is 85%. Finally, queen breeding through larva transferring is conducted on the small larvae, and chimera bee queens are obtained. According to the method, an eye color gene white of the bees is taken as a target gene, the chimera bee queens with obvious phenotypes are obtained, in addition, afterthe injection, sequencing is conducted on the hatched small larvae, and the result shows that the gene editing efficiency reaches 90.9% by adopting the method. Therefore, the gene editing method for target gene knockout in the Italian bee field is established.(ZH) 本发明涉及一种蜜蜂CRISPR‑Cas9基因编辑方法，首先将Cas9蛋白与靶基因gRNA混合成终浓度均为500ng/ul的混合溶液。然后对被产下不超过1.5小时的受精卵进行注射，每颗受精卵的注射体积为1.2nl，蜂卵的显微注射在1小时内完成。接着将完成注射的蜂卵置于恒温恒湿培养箱中培养至孵化成小幼虫，蜂卵的培养条件为温度34.5℃，相对湿度为85%。最后对小幼虫进行移虫育王，得到嵌合体蜂王。本发明以蜜蜂眼色基因white为靶基因，得到有明显表型的嵌合体蜂王，另外，注射后对孵化的小幼虫进行测序，结果表明本发明有90.9%的基因编辑效率。从而建立了在意大利蜜蜂领域中敲除靶基因的基因编辑方法。

(EN) The invention discloses application of a knockout soybean GmDMEb gene in increasing the number of soybean plant branches and increasing the soybean yield, and belongs to the technical field of gene engineering. In order to excavate a gene capable of regulating and controlling the branching number of a soybean plant, construct an ideal soybean plant type and increase the yield of the soybean, a soybean GmDMEb gene knockout vector is constructed by utilizing a CRISPR-Cas9 system, the vector is utilized to convert agrobacterium and infect the soybean to obtain a transgenic soybean with the GmDMEb gene knockout, and the GmDMEb gene knockout can increase the branching number of the soybean plant and improve the yield of the soybean. And the soybean yield can be improved. The invention provides a theoretical basis for creating dominant soybeans and breeding high-yield soybean varieties, and has important theoretical significance and application value.(ZH) 敲除大豆GmDMEb基因在增加大豆植株分枝数及提高大豆产量中的应用，属于基因工程技术领域。为了挖掘能够调控大豆植株分枝数的基因，构建大豆理想株型、提高大豆产量，本发明利用CRISPR‑Cas9系统构建了大豆GmDMEb基因敲除载体，利用该载体转化农杆菌，然后侵染大豆获得了GmDMEb基因敲除的转基因大豆，证实了敲除GmDMEb基因能够增加大豆植株分枝数，并且能够提高大豆产量。本发明为创制优势大豆和大豆高产品种选育提供理论依据，具有重要理论意义和应用价值。

(EN) The present invention relates to a genome editing composition using a CRISPR/Cpf1 system and a use thereof and, more particularly, to a genome editing composition comprising: a CRISPR RNA (crRNA) including a guide sequence capable of hybridizing with a target nucleotide sequence, and a uridine repeat sequence connected to the 3'-terminus of the guide sequence, or a DNA coding therefor; and a Cpf1protein or a DNA coding therefor, a genome editing method using the same, a method for construction of a transgenic entity, and a transgenic entity. Utilizing the CRIPSPR/Cpf1 system, the present invention can increase an indel efficiency and decrease off-target activity in genome editing and thus can easily construct a transformed cell or transgenic animal or plant having a desired gene insertedthereinto (knock-in) or deleted therefrom (knock-out).(ZH) 本发明涉及使用CRISPR/Cpf1系统的基因组编辑组合物及其用途，并且更具体地，涉及基因组编辑组合物，其包含：包含能够与靶核苷酸序列杂交的指导序列和连接至所述指导序列的3’末端的尿苷重复序列的CRISPR RNA(crRNA)或其编码DNA；以及Cpf1蛋白或其编码DNA，使用所述组合物的基因组编辑方法、转基因实体的构建方法以及转基因实体。使用CRIPSPR/Cpf1系统，本发明可以在基因组编辑中提高插失效率并降低脱靶活性，并且因此可以容易地构建具有插入其中(敲入)或从其中缺失(敲除)的期望基因的转化细胞或者转基因动物或植物。

(EN) The invention provides novel synthetic small nuclear RNA (snRNA) promoters which are useful for CRISPR-mediated targeted gene modifications in plants. The invention also provides methods and compositions for use for the snRNA promoters driving expression of guide RNAs and non-coding RNAs for development of plants and plant cells comprising modified genomes.(FR) L'invention concerne de nouveaux promoteurs synthétiques de petit ARN nucléaire (ARNsn) qui sont utiles pour des modifications génétiques ciblées à médiation par CRISPR dans des plantes. L'invention concerne également des procédés et des compositions destinés à être utilisés pour les promoteurs d'ARNsn entraînant l'expression d'ARN guides et d'ARN non codants pour le développement de plantes et de cellules végétales comprenant des génomes modifiés.

(EN) The invention discloses a medicago sativa CRISPR/Cas9 multi-target editing system and an application thereof. The invention provides an expression vector for multi-target editing of a CRISPR/Cas9 genome of medicago sativa, the expression vector comprises three sgRNA expression cassettes, promoters in the three sgRNA expression cassettes are respectively MsU6-d1promoter (the first site to the 500 site of SEQ ID No.1), MsU6g1promoter (the 789th site to the 1317th site of SEQ ID No.1) and MsU6-d3promoter (the 1606th site to the 2095th site of SEQ ID No.1), and the sgRNA1, the sgRNA2 and the sgRNA3 can aim at the same target gene or different target genes of the medicago sativa. Three targets are designed according to the characteristics of the alfalfa autotetraploid to target the same gene or different genes, the optimized genome editing system greatly improves the alfalfa gene editing efficiency, the plant gene editing efficiency can reach 42.9%, the double-target co-editing efficiency can reach 14.3%, and the three-target co-editing efficiency can reach 7.1%.(ZH) 本发明公开了紫花苜蓿CRISPR/Cas9多靶点编辑系统及其应用。本发明提供了一种用于紫花苜蓿CRISPR/Cas9基因组多靶点编辑的表达载体，包括三个sgRNA表达盒，三个sgRNA表达盒中启动子分别为MsU6‑d1promoter(SEQ ID No.1的第1‑500位)、MsU6g1promoter(SEQ ID No.1的第789‑1317位)和MsU6‑d3promoter(SEQ ID No.1的第1606‑2095位)，所述sgRNA1、所述sgRNA2和所述sgRNA3可针对紫花苜蓿的同一靶标基因或不同靶标基因。本发明根据紫花苜蓿同源四倍体的特点设计三个靶点，靶向同一基因或不同基因，本发明这种优化的基因组编辑系统大大提高了紫花苜蓿基因编辑效率，植株基因编辑效率可达42.9％，双靶点共编辑效率可达14.3％，三靶点共编辑效率可达7.1％。

(EN) The invention discloses an application of a cytokinin oxidase gene in increasing the zinc and iron content of plant grains, and the cytokinin oxidase gene is a TaCKX5 gene and encodes a TaCKX5 protein. According to the invention, a wheat TaCKX5 gene is knocked out by adopting a CRISPR/Cas9 technology, and a new wheat germplasm with obviously improved grain zinc content and grain iron content under a low-nitrogen condition is obtained. According to the method, the zinc content and/or the iron content of the grains are/is increased, wheat germplasm resources are innovated, and the method has important significance on new variety cultivation, environmental protection and grain safety and has great application and popularization value.(ZH) 本发明公开了细胞分裂素氧化酶基因在提高植物籽粒锌铁含量中的应用，所述细胞分裂素氧化酶基因为TaCKX5基因，编码TaCKX5蛋白。本发明采用CRISPR/Cas9技术敲除了小麦TaCKX5基因，获得了低氮条件下籽粒锌含量和籽粒铁含量明显提高的小麦新种质。本发明提高了籽粒锌含量和/或铁含量，创新了小麦种质资源，对新品种培育、环境保护和粮食安全具有重要意义，具有重大的应用推广价值。

(EN) The invention discloses a rice receptor kinase gene LOC_Os11g47290 as well as an encoded protein and an application thereof. According to the application of the rice receptor kinase gene LOC_Os11g47290 and the encoded protein thereof in regulation and control of plant disease resistance, the resistance of rice to bacterial blight can be remarkably improved by destroying the biological function ofthe encoded protein of the LOC_Os11g47290 gene. The efficient LOC_Os11g47290 gene fixed-point knockout is realized by using a CRISPR/Cas9 technology, and after the rice is inoculated with bacterial blight bacteria GD1358 and V, the scab length is obviously shortened. The new function of the LOC_Os11g47290 gene provided by the invention provides a new method for disease-resistant breeding of plants, and the LOC_Os11g47290 gene has very important application value in agricultural production.(ZH) 本发明公开了水稻受体激酶基因LOC_Os11g47290及其编码蛋白与应用。本发明发现水稻受体激酶基因LOC_Os11g47290及其编码蛋白在调控植物抗病性中的应用，通过破坏LOC_Os11g47290基因的编码蛋白的生物学功能能够显著提高水稻对白叶枯病的抗性。本发明利用CRISPR/Cas9技术实现了高效的LOC_Os11g47290基因定点敲除，定点敲除水稻接种白叶枯病菌GD1358和V后，病斑长度显著缩短。本发明提供的LOC_Os11g47290基因的新功能为植物抗病育种提供了新方法，在农业生产上具有十分重要的应用价值。

(EN) The invention relates to a CRISPR (Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats)/ Cas9 system knockout populus alba PDS (phytoene desaturase) gene and application thereof, and belongs tothe technical field of molecular breeding. The nucleotide sequence of the populus alba PDS gene is disclosed in SEQ ID NO.1. A target site disclosed by the invention can realize the fixed point editing of the PDS gene, and the nucleotide sequence of the target site is disclosed in SEQ ID NO.2. The invention provides a new scheme for researching the gene function of a woody mode plant, a native tree variety populus alba molecular breeding platform in China is established, and technical support is provided for directionally culturing a forest new variety which adapts to Chinese economic development requirements.(ZH) 本发明涉及CRISPR/Cas9系统敲除银白杨PDS基因及其应用，属于分子育种技术领域。本发明所述银白杨八氢番茄红素脱氢酶(PDS)基因的核苷酸序列如SEQ ID NO.1所示。本发明所述靶位点能够实现对PDS基因的定点编辑，靶位点的核苷酸序列如SEQ ID NO.2所示。本发明为木本模式植物的基因功能研究提供了新的方案，建立了我国本土树种银白杨分子育种平台，为定向培育适应我国经济发展需求的林木新品种提供了技术支持。

(EN) The invention discloses a plant glandular hair specific expression gene HD-9 as well as an expression vector and application thereof, and aims to solve the technical problem of lack of plant glandular hair head secretory cell development regulation means at present. The gene HD-9 capable of regulating and controlling development of glandular hair cells is identified, an overexpression vector and a CRISPR/Cas9 vector of the gene are constructed, and a corresponding overexpression strain and a gene knockout strain are obtained through conversion respectively. Phenotype and physiological feature identification and detection show that: the HD-9 gene can regulate and control the development of glandular head cells of plant long-stem glandular hair, and has important application value in the aspects of regulating and increasing the content of glandular hair secretions, directionally improving glandular hair types and the like.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种植物腺毛特异表达基因HD‑9、其表达载体及应用，旨在解决当前缺乏植物腺毛头部分泌细胞发育调控手段的技术问题。本发明鉴定出一个可调控腺毛细胞发育的基因HD‑9，构建了该基因的过表达载体和CRISPR/Cas9载体，并分别转化获得对应过表达株系和基因敲除株系；经表型和生理特征鉴定、检测表明，HD‑9基因能够调控植物长柄腺毛腺头细胞的发育，其在调控增加腺毛分泌物含量、定向改良腺毛类型等方面具有重要的应用价值。

(EN) The invention provides novel synthetic small nuclear RNA (snRNA) promoters which are useful for CRISPR-mediated targeted gene modifications in plants. The invention also provides methods and compositions for use for the snRNA promoters driving expression of guide RNAs and non-coding RNAs for development of plants and plant cells comprising modified genomes.(FR) L'invention concerne de nouveaux promoteurs synthétiques de petit ARN nucléaire (ARNsn) qui sont utiles pour des modifications génétiques ciblées à médiation par CRISPR dans des plantes. L'invention concerne également des procédés et des compositions destinés à être utilisés pour les promoteurs d'ARNsn entraînant l'expression d'ARN guides et d'ARN non codants pour le développement de plantes et de cellules végétales comprenant des génomes modifiés.

(EN) The invention relates to the field of plant biotechnology and genetic breeding technology, in particular to an application of plant amino acid permease and coding genes thereof to regulation and control of high temperature resistance of plants. The invention discloses participation of a ZmAAPa gene of corn amino acid permease in regulation and control of the tolerance of corn pollen to high temperature stress. The knockout of the ZmAAPa gene can significantly improve the tolerance of the corn pollen to the high temperature stress. A corn material with the ZmAAPa gene knocked out is obtained through a CRISPR/Cas9 technology and corn genetic transformation, the germination rate of the corn pollen under the high temperature stress condition is remarkably increased through knockout of the ZmAAPa gene, and normal development of pollen and anther is not affected.(ZH) 本发明涉及植物生物技术和遗传育种技术领域，具体涉及植物氨基酸通透酶及其编码基因在调控植物耐高温性能中的应用。本发明公开了玉米氨基酸通透酶ZmAAPa基因参与调控玉米花粉对高温胁迫的耐受性。ZmAAPa基因的敲除可以显著提高玉米花粉对高温胁迫的耐受性。本发明通过CRISPR/Cas9技术及玉米遗传转化获得了ZmAAPa基因敲除的玉米材料，ZmAAPa基因的敲除显著提高了玉米花粉在高温胁迫条件下的萌发率，且不影响花粉和花药的正常发育。

(EN) 
This invention relates to CRISPR-Cas nucleases codon optimized for expression in plants and nucleic acid constructs encoding base editors comprising a CRISPR-Cas nuclease and a deaminase domain, wherein the nucleic acid constructs are optimized for expression in a plant. The invention further relates to methods of modifying nucleic acids using the nucleic acid constructs.

(EN) The present invention relates to a method for producing Solanum lycopersicum male sterile 10 (SlMS10) gene knockout tomato plant using a CRISPR/Cas9 system and a male sterile tomato plant produced by the method. The male-sterile tomato plants through the CRISPR/Cas9 system are produced, the SlMS10 gene can be rapidly introduced into elite lines, and the time required to remove linkage drag is reduced compared to conventional breeding methods. A composition for genome correction for inducing male sterility in tomato plants comprises: a complex (ribonucleoprotein) of guide RNA and endonuclease protein specific for a target sequence of the tomato-derived SlMS10 gene; or a recombinant vector containing DNA encoding a guide RNA specific to the target sequence of the tomato-derived SlMS10 gene and a nucleic acid sequence encoding an endonuclease protein. (EN) The invention relates to the technical field of plant genetic engineering, in particular to the function and application of the rice Os11g0681100 gene and its coding protein. According to the invention, it is found that the rice Os11g0681100 gene and its coding protein participate in regulating the immune response of rice to bacterial blight, and the resistance of rice to bacterial blight can be significantly improved by destroying the biological function of the coding protein of the Os11g0681100 gene. The invention utilizes the CRISPR/Cas9 technology to realize high-efficiency fixed-point knockout of the Os11g0681100 gene. After inoculating rice plants with Xanthomonas oryzae pv.oryzae, the length of disease spots is significantly shortened. The new function of the OS11G0681100 gene provided by the invention provides a new method for plant disease resistance breeding and has very important application value in agricultural production.(ZH) 本发明涉及植物基因工程技术领域，具体涉及水稻Os11g0681100基因及其编码蛋白的功能和应用。本发明发现水稻Os11g0681100基因及其编码蛋白参与调控水稻对白叶枯病的免疫响应，通过破坏Os11g0681100基因编码蛋白的生物学功能能够显著提高水稻对白叶枯病的抗性。本发明利用CRISPR/Cas9技术实现了高效的Os11g0681100基因的定点敲除，定点敲除水稻植株接种白枯病菌后，病斑长度显著缩短。本发明提供的Os11g0681100基因的新功能为植物抗病育种提供了新方法，在农业生产中具有十分重要的应用价值。

(EN) Compositions and methods are provided for high-efficiency large scale manipulation of genomic regions and chromosomal engineering of plant genomes. Enhancement of chromosomal modification includes the provision of one or more linker oligonucleotides complementary to the distinct chromosomal ends following double strand breaks, increasing the temperature effect and/or recurrent cutting by an endonuclease to facilitate higher chromosomal modification including large segment translocations and recombination. Site-specific directed DNA breaks under one or more of the experimental conditions (including CRISPR-Cas systems) disclosed enhance targeted recombination frequencies, crossover efficiency and movement of large chromosomal segments in crop plant cells.(FR) L'invention concerne des compositions et des procédés pour la manipulation à grande échelle et à haute efficacité de régions génomiques et l'ingénierie chromosomique de génomes végétaux. L'amélioration de la modification chromosomique comprend la fourniture d'un ou plusieurs oligonucléotides de liaison complémentaires aux extrémités chromosomiques distinctes suite à des cassures double brin, l'augmentation de l'effet de température et/ou la coupe récurrente par une endonucléase pour faciliter une modification chromosomique plus élevée comprenant des translocations et la recombinaison de grands segments. Des cassures d'ADN dirigées spécifiques au site dans une ou plusieurs des conditions expérimentales (notamment les systèmes CRISPR-Cas) divulguées améliorent les fréquences de recombinaison ciblées, l'efficacité de croisement et le mouvement de grands segments chromosomiques dans des cellules végétales cultivées.

(EN) The invention relates to a DNA modifying enzyme comprising or consisting of a DNA editing protein and a Cas protein and a peptide linker, wherein said DNA editing protein and said Cas protein are connected by said peptide linker; and wherein said DNA modifying enzyme has been obtained by directed molecular evolution of an original enzyme; and wherein said DNA modifying enzyme shows a base editing rate which is at least 4-foldhigher than the base editing rate of said wildtype enzyme. The invention relates further to a method of directed molecular evolution of a DNA modifying enzyme and to the use evolved DNA modifying enzymes in research, medicine and agriculture.(FR) L'invention concerne une enzyme de modification d'ADN comprenant une protéine d'édition d'ADN et une protéine Cas et un lieur peptidique, ou en étant constitués, ladite protéine d'édition d'ADN et ladite protéine Cas étant reliées par ledit lieur peptidique ; et ladite enzyme de modification d'ADN ayant été obtenue par évolution moléculaire dirigée d'une enzyme d'origine ; et ladite enzyme de modification d'ADN présentant un taux d'édition de base qui est au moins 4 fois supérieur au taux d'édition de base de ladite enzyme de type sauvage. L'invention concerne en outre un procédé d'évolution moléculaire dirigée d'une enzyme de modification d'ADN et l'utilisation d'enzymes de modification d'ADN évoluées dans la recherche, la médecine et l'agriculture.

(EN) The invention discloses an MLO gene mutant as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The invention discloses a method for improving sclerotinia rot resistance of colza by using a gene editing technology, and particularly relates to a method for simultaneously mutating 6 homologous copies of a BnMLO6 gene by using a CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing technology to obtain a stably inherited material (bnmlo6 for short) in which the 6 homologous copies of the BnMLO6 gene are simultaneously mutated. Field and indoor observation results show that the rape bnmlo6 material not only shows relatively strong powdery mildew resistance, but also can improve the resistance of the rape to sclerotiniose. It is reported for the first time that the BnMLO6 gene can improve the resistance of rape to sclerotiniose and powdery mildew at the same time, and the BnMLO6 gene has wide application prospects.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种MLO基因突变体及其制备方法与应用，属于生物技术领域。本发明公开了一种利用基因编辑技术提高油菜菌核病抗性的方法，具体利用CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑技术对BnMLO6基因6个同源拷贝同时突变，获得稳定遗传的BnMLO6基因6个同源拷贝同时突变的材料(简称为bnmlo6)。田间和室内观察结果表明，油菜bnmlo6材料不仅表现出较强的白粉病抗性，而且也能提高油菜对菌核病的抗性。本发明首次报道了BnMLO6基因可以同时提高油菜对菌核病和白粉病的抗性，具有广阔的应用前景。

(EN) The invention discloses a novel rice susceptible gene OsBSG1, a function identification method thereof and application of the novel rice susceptible gene OsBSG1 in cultivation of a novel broad-spectrum disease-resistant, high-quality and high-yield rice variety. The OsBSG1 gene is cloned according to rice genome annotation information. The CDS sequence length of the gene is 2580bp, and the gene encodes a protein with the length of 859 amino acids. The CRISPR/Cas9 mutant of the OsBSG1 gene is subjected to rice blast resistance identification, and the broad-spectrum high rice blast resistance of the mutant is found; the thousand seed weight of the grains is increased, and the quality is better. Exploration of the new susceptible gene OsBSG1 provides precious gene resources and theoretical guidance for breeding of new varieties of broad-spectrum rice blast-resistant, high-yield and high-quality rice.(ZH) 本发明公开了水稻感病新基因OsBSG1及其功能鉴定方法和在培育广谱抗病且优质高产水稻新品种中的应用。根据水稻基因组注释信息，克隆OsBSG1基因。该基因CDS序列长2580bp，编码长859氨基酸的蛋白。对OsBSG1基因的CRISPR/Cas9突变体进行稻瘟病的抗性鉴定，发现其突变体广谱高抗稻瘟病；而且其籽粒千粒重增加、品质更优。感病新基因OsBSG1的发掘，为广谱抗稻瘟病且高产优质水稻新品种的选育提供珍贵的基因资源和理论指导。

(EN) 
The invention provides novel synthetic small nuclear RNA (snRNA) promoters which are useful for CRISPR-mediated targeted gene modifications in plants. The invention also provides methods and compositions for use for the snRNA promoters driving expression of guide RNAs and non-coding RNAs for development of plants and plant cells comprising modified genomes.

(EN) The invention belongs to the technical field of plant genetic engineering, and relates to an NtHSP70-8 gene, particularly to a flue-cured tobacco ash hanging related gene and application thereof. According to the invention, a NtHSP70-8 gene mutation tobacco strain is obtained through a CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing technology, wherein after the Cas9 background is removed through selfing, the genetic stability is higher, and stable inheritance can be achieved among different generations; and the baking characteristics of the tobacco leaves can be influenced by moisture loss in the baking and modulating process, and gene resources are provided for cultivating and improving new tobacco varieties capable of reducing ash hanging of flue-cured tobacco.(ZH) 本发明属于植物基因工程技术领域，涉及NtHSP70‑8基因，特别是指与烤烟挂灰相关的基因及其应用。本发明利用CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑技术获得了NtHSP70‑8基因突变的烟草株系，一方面通过自交去掉Cas9背景后遗传稳定性更强，能够在不同世代间稳定遗传；另一方面可以在烘烤调制过程通过水分的散失影响烟叶的烘烤特性，为培育和改良具有减少烤烟挂灰的烟草新品种提供基因资源。

(EN) The invention discloses an OsCDPK14 gene for reducing the maturing rate of rice, a protein obtained by encoding the OsCDPK14 gene and application of the OsCDPK14 gene, and relates to the field of biotechnology and breeding. According to the scheme, the function of the OsCDPK14 gene on reducing the maturing rate of the rice is verified in the rice through a gene knockout experiment; a mutant plant is obtained by constructing a CRISPR/Cas9 gene knockout vector to transform rice, the maturing rate of the mutant plant is remarkably reduced compared with that of a wild plant, it is indicated that the OsCDPK14 gene has the function of regulating and controlling the maturing rate of the rice, the biological function of the OsCDPK14 gene on reduction of the maturing rate of the rice is disclosed for the first time, and the application of the OsCDPK14 gene on reduction of the maturing rate of the rice is promoted. A new thought is provided for clarification of a complex agronomic trait related molecular mechanism, a theoretical foundation is laid for further rice yield breeding research and utilization, and a potential new gene resource is provided for rice breeding.(ZH) 本申请公开一种降低水稻结实率的OsCDPK14基因及其编码得到的蛋白和应用，涉及生物技术和育种领域；本方案通过基因敲除实验在水稻中验证了OsCDPK14基因在降低水稻结实率上的功能；通过构建CRISPR/Cas9基因敲除载体转化水稻，获得突变体植株，突变体植株结实率与野生型植株相比显著性降低，表明OsCDPK14基因具有调控水稻结实率的功能，本申请首次揭示了OsCDPK14基因于降低水稻结实率上的生物学功能，为阐明结实率这一复杂的农艺性状相关的分子机制提供了新的思路，为进一步水稻产量育种研究和利用奠定理论基础，为水稻育种提供了潜在的新基因资源。
